summary: The diff implements a comprehensive Halal Muslim themed endless runner game covering most requirements. The core gameplay (REQ-1), Islamic environment (REQ-2), collectibles/HUD (REQ-3), power-ups (REQ-4), character selection (REQ-5), leaderboard backend (REQ-6), visual theme (REQ-7), and menu/game-over screens (REQ-8) are all present. However, several specific acceptance criteria have gaps: the character selection screen uses 2D emoji previews rather than actual 3D mesh figures; the Buraq Boost visual trail effect is not clearly implemented in the truncated diff; and the backend uses a Map keyed by nickname which overwrites previous entries rather than storing each run record.

missing_requirements.requirement: Characters are rendered as simple 3D mesh figures with culturally appropriate clothing in the character selection screen
missing_requirements.reason: The CharacterSelect screen uses 2D emoji representations (e.g., 🧢, 🧕, 👳) in the selection cards rather than actual 3D mesh figures. Only the in-game GameScene renders 3D character meshes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Buraq Boost shows a visual trail effect
missing_requirements.reason: The Buraq Boost increases speed (buraqSpeed = speed * 1.5) but no explicit visual trail effect implementation is visible in the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend stores run records per run — multiple runs per player should be persisted
missing_requirements.reason: The backend uses a Map keyed by nickname, meaning submitting a score for the same nickname overwrites the previous entry rather than storing all run records per run.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication provider integrated into the app
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly excludes Internet Identity / wallet authentication as a non-goal, yet the codebase includes a full useInternetIdentity hook with AuthClient, login/logout flows, and the InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the entire app.

hallucinated_features.description: Speed meter visual indicator displayed on the HUD
hallucinated_features.reason: The GameHUD includes a visual speed meter with 5 bars at the bottom of the screen. A visible speed HUD indicator was not specified in any requirement — only the speed mechanic itself was required.
